title: First Sitting of 1st Session of 2025

items.text: The Speaker of the People's Majlis opens the sitting.
The Speaker invites the President to deliver the Presidential Address that the President must present to the Majlis under Article 84 of the Constitution.
President Dr Mohamed Muizzu delivers the Presidential Address.

summary: The first sitting of the 2025 parliamentary year was scheduled solely for President Dr Mohamed Muizzu to deliver the annual Presidential Address required by Article 84 of the Constitution.
